subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Blast
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Blast'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blast** means a powerful explosion or a sudden release of energy (विस्फोट)
 
• **Blow up **means to cause an explosion or to destroy something with an explosion.(विस्फोट होना)
 
• It is a **synonym of "blast"** as both imply a sudden release of energy.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Blow up'. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Recall:** To bring back or remember something from the past.(याद करना)
 
• **Plead: **To make an emotional or earnest appeal or request. (गुज़ारिश करना)
 
• **Share:** To divide or distribute something among multiple people.(साझा करना)

The correct answer is 'Option 1'</st
